statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"' | sed 's/^Claude //'); used=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); dir=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // empty'); branch=''; [ -n "$dir" ] && branch=$(git -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); out="$model"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out | $branch"; [ -n "$used" ] && out="$out | ctx: ${used}%"; printf '%s' "$out"

hooks.command: osascript -e 'display notification "確認が必要です" with title "Claude Code"'
jq -r '.stop_hook_active' | grep -q false && osascript -e 'display notification "タスクが完了しました" with title "Claude Code"'
